control_failures.control_label: exclusion of people from beneath elevated work
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: corrective action - material unwanted event control at HO-9402

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9402 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically selecting and inspecting lifting gear. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 11 May 2024 a corrective action on HO-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
